items:
Summary:

Nestled along the shores of coastal dune Oyster Lake, our Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental provides a majestic retreat for your next getaway. Our property boasts 8 spacious bedrooms and a private pool, ensuring comfort for up to 24 guests, including a private carriage house with a separate kitchen for added privacy. Enjoy mornings on the dock, golf cart rides to town or a short walk or to the sand, just 9 minutes away. Experience the best of the pool, lake, and beach at this luxe estate.



The Space:

Step inside this expansive 4,840-square-foot lakefront estate, where modern luxury meets coastal comfort. The main house features an open-concept living area anchored by a massive 85" Smart TV and a gourmet chef’s kitchen. This well-stocked kitchen is equipped with high-end finishes, a Keurig, a drip coffee maker, and a toaster oven, perfect for preparing large family feasts. With multiple king suites and a massive third-floor bunk room that can sleep a crowd, our property is designed for privacy and ease. For added flexibility, the carriage house serves as a self-contained retreat, featuring two private bedrooms and its own full kitchen, making it ideal for separate families or groups traveling together.



The outdoor living space is a private oasis designed for ultimate relaxation and recreation. Transition seamlessly from the house to the sun-drenched patio, where you’ll find a private pool and a hot tub overlooking the serene waters of Oyster Lake. Whether you are taking a refreshing dip or soaking in the spa at sunset, the views of the coastal dune lake provide a breathtaking backdrop. The estate also includes a private wooden dock, offering a peaceful spot for morning coffee or direct water access for a day of lakefront fun.



Adventure is at your fingertips with a premium collection of amenities included with your stay. Explore the calm waters of Oyster Lake using the provided kayaks and paddleboards, or take the 6-person golf cart for a quick spin or walk (9 minutes) to the Gulf’s sugar-white sands. If you prefer to travel on two wheels, hop on the provided bikes to cruise the scenic 30A corridor. After a day of exploring Dune Allen and the surrounding beach communities, return to our property and enjoy the convenience of on-site parking for up to 8 vehicles in the large private driveway.



Location perks: Oyster Lake (on-site), Oyster Bay (on-site),West Allen Loop Beach Access, (0.5 miles), Fort Panic Beach Access (0.7 miles), Dune Allen Regional Beach Access (0.9 Miles), Stallworth Beach Access (1.4 miles)



Interior

— Kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, blender, kettle, toaster oven, cooking utensils, tableware)

— 7 Smart TVs (85" in the living room)

— Game room with pool and ping pong table

— Desk/Monitor work space

— In-unit laundry room

— Free WiFi (500 Mbps)

— Central heat and A/C

— 4,840 sq. ft.



Exterior

— Private pool

— Private in-pool hot tub

— Private wooden dock

— 6 seat golf cart

— 6 bikes

— Paddle boards and kayaks for the lake

— On-site parking for 8 vehicles in the driveway (no garage access)



Floor Configuration

Main Floor - Bedroom 1: King bed (inferred) with en-suite bathroom (walk-in shower), living room, kitchen, dining area

Middle Floor (Second Floor) - Bedroom 2 (Master): King bed with en-suite bathroom (walk-in rain shower), Bedroom 3: King bed with Jack and Jill bathroom access, Bedroom 4: King bed with Jack and Jill bathroom access, Bedroom 5: King bed with en-suite bathroom, Lap-top friendly work space, Laundry room

Top Floor - Bedroom 6 (Bunk Room): 2 Bunk beds (twin over full and full over full), 2 full beds and 1 twin with bathroom access, game room, wet bar with mini fridge, patio access

Cottage House - Bedroom 7: Queen bed, Bedroom 8: 2 twin beds, full kitchen, shared full bathroom



Guest Access:

Guests have exclusive access to the entire 8-bedroom estate, including the main house and the carriage house suite with the exception of the garage. This access includes the private pool, the in-pool hot tub, and the private wooden dock. On-site parking for up to 8 vehicles is available in the private driveway.



The Neighborhood:

Located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, this neighborhood offers a tranquil coastal vibe centered around the natural beauty of Oyster Lake and the Gulf of Mexico. The area is renowned for its sugar-white sand beaches and rare coastal dune lakes. Guests can enjoy a variety of activities including paddleboarding on the lake, cycling along the scenic 30A corridor, or exploring local boutique shops and upscale dining in nearby seaside communities.



Getting Around:

A car is recommended to fully enjoy the attractions and beaches along the 30A corridor. Guests will have access to 6 bikes and a 6-seat golf cart. Our property offers significant on-site parking with space for up to 8 vehicles in the private driveway.



Other Things to Note:

Please note that the pool and hot tub are serviced between guests.



Please note that the garage is not accessible.



Interaction with Guests:

We are offsite but available when needed. Please message us through the app or booking platform for the quickest response.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Looking to get your feet wet? Snorkeling and fishing adventures can be found near the property.
